answer: PoA resists Sybil control by bonding every identity’s collateral in a vault and linking equivocation evidence across identities: when k coordinated agents sign conflicting histories, the penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. A canyon of aliases provides no shelter; detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes a planted vine of identities economically self-defeating.
